trigger: I am a woman being arrested
description: Steps and dignity protections if you are a woman being arrested or searched.

steps.text: Stay calm and do not resist, even if the arrest feels unfair.
You have a right to dignity; you must not be treated in a degrading way (s.34(1)).
Ask to be searched by a female officer and in a private place.
Say: 'I wish to remain silent until I speak to my lawyer' (s.35(2)).
Ask that your family or a trusted person be informed.
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the station.
Call your lawyer or a trusted person now.
